title: Still Sick
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Office worker Makoto Shimizu secretly draws and sells yuri doujinshi, until her coworker Akane Maekawa spots her at a yuri exhibition. Akane turns out to be a former professional manga artist whose series never took off, and Makoto promises to help her return to drawing as the two grow closer.
life_message: Owning your passions and supporting someone else's dream can heal old failures and open the way to love.

content.note: Workplace secrecy and fear of exposure.
